title: Brush contact must remove dirt
problem: Native f1028-1074 shows brush ripples and lifted black drips while the basin remains dark; the next shot jumps to a spotless wide.
beats: Roshan plants the brush on a small visible dirty strip inside the tub.
One short scrub moves grime into the bristles and exposes the same tub surface underneath.
She lifts the brush after the clean strip is readable.
end_state: A clearly cleaned strip remains where the brush touched; untouched dirt remains elsewhere.
must_not_move: tub rim, faucet, Roshan support pose and hand count
negative_constraints: no whole-room instant cleanup, floating brush or fountain-like brush spray
review_priority_note: Direct observed defect or explicit new owner direction.
